_note: Tutorials for the Map tab's Places and Region views. The same rules as table.json's note; the numbers come from rules/tutorialfacts.py so the cards say what rules/hexes.py and rules/survival.py do.

steps.title: Places
steps.words: Places shows the town as you know it, laid out on a tabletop. Press Places again to go back to the ground you are standing on.

steps.title: The fog
steps.words: Where you have stood is painted, places you have only seen are grey, and the rest is cloud. It fills in as you find things and never shows what you have not. The layout is a sketch: distance on it is not distance walked.

source.literal: `visited` (stood in) is kept apart from seen

steps.title: Going somewhere
steps.words: Press a place for its card: how you know it and the way there. Walk there attaches the whole walk to your turn, and Say sets off. Something on the way, a meeting or the watch at a gate, can stop you.

source.literal: the engine walks every hop of it in one turn

steps.title: The maps above
steps.words: The names along the top are the maps above this one: the region, the continent, the world. Press one, or zoom out past a map, to open the one above it.

buttons.words: Shows the tips for the map you are looking at.

steps.title: One hex a move
steps.words: Each hex is {hex_miles} miles across. Press any hex you have seen and you walk there, a hex at a time. For most walkers open plain takes {hex_hours_open} hours a hex and rougher ground {hex_hours_rough}; slower walkers take longer.

steps.title: Each stop
steps.words: Where you stop you look round, and every hex the look covers clears on the map. A meeting, a fight, something new in sight or the end of the day stops you on the way, and the story says which.

source.literal: stops short where a meeting, a fight, a new sighting or the end of

steps.title: Past a day's travel
steps.words: After {march_free_hours} hours on the way since you last rested, the day's travel is done. Going on is a forced march: a Constitution check each hour, DC {march_dc_first} and {march_dc_step} more every hour, with {march_damage} non-lethal and fatigue on a failure.

steps.title: Water
steps.words: By a coast the buttons say how you cross: sail in your own ship, row a hired boat, or swim. A swim says what it will cost you before you press it.

steps.title: Buttons under Travel
steps.words: Each button names a way you can step, with the ground and the hours it takes.

buttons.label: Walk to
buttons.words: A site you spotted further off, walked a hex at a time.

buttons.label: Go into
buttons.words: Enter the tower, ruin, mine or cave in the hex you stand on.

steps.title: The ground
steps.words: This is the ground you stand on, square by square. Everyone in the scene has a square from the moment they arrive and keeps it until they move. Press a square or a person, and the line under the board says what is there.

steps.title: How to look at it
steps.words: Where a room has more than one level, Looking at picks the floor you see; people on another floor are faded, not hidden. With the figures, Turn left and Turn right swing the board round.

buttons.label: Flat
buttons.words: The ground from above, every square lettered and numbered along the edges.

buttons.label: 3D
buttons.words: The same ground as figures on a table.

buttons.label: Places
buttons.words: The town as you know it, under its fog.

steps.title: Zoom and pan
steps.words: The wheel zooms where you point. Drag, or hold the middle button, to pan. With the figures, drag with the right button, or press Q and E, to turn the board any way you like.

buttons.words: Zoom in; the plus key too.
Zoom out; the minus key too.

buttons.label: Fit
buttons.words: The whole board in view again.

steps.title: The Key
steps.words: Key opens over the board and names the colours: you, allies, foes and bystanders, and in a fight whose turn it is, the squares a foe threatens and the moves that would provoke.

buttons.words: Shows the tips for the map you are looking at.

steps.title: Push on
steps.words: Push on only arms the march: nothing happens until you press the hex to go to, and Stop for the day takes it back.

source.literal:
sent with
// the next move only, then disarmed

steps.title: The world's shape
steps.words: The Continent shows its nations and the cities you know in them; the World shows its continents. Point at the land to light it, then press it or zoom in on it to go in. Zoom out past a map to open the one above.

steps.title: Cities you know
steps.words: A city is drawn once you know of it: stood in, signed on a road out of a town, heard of in talk, or read on a map. Press one for how you know it.

source.literal: const HOW_WORDS = { been: "stood in", road: "from road signs", heard: "heard of", map: "from maps" };

steps.title: How far
steps.words: A city's card lists each leg of the way by the roads you know, with its miles and the days it takes. Journeys set out from the road out of town. A city no road you know reaches says so.

source.literal: Journeys set out from the road out of town.

steps.title: By sea
steps.words: On a continent, By sea from lists where ships sail from every port you have stood in. A passage is booked with the harbourmaster in that port.

buttons.label: Open the town map
buttons.words: From the city you are in, back down to its streets.
Shows the tips for the map you are looking at.

steps.title: What the sea holds
steps.words: At sea you meet only what lives in salt water, and other ships: merchants, pirates and the navy of a real nation. An island, a wreck, a survivor or a stowaway may turn up as well.

source.literal:
at sea, only
    aquatic creatures and ships

steps.title: Passage
steps.words: While you talk with a harbourmaster, the berths they offer show as buttons. Press one to attach it to your turn, and Say books it. The days of a passage pass aboard, not on the road.

steps.title: Afloat
steps.words: Aboard your own ship the Region moves her a hex at a time under sail. Land beside her is reached in her boat, or she ties up at a port. From a hired rowboat, land beside you is a landfall.

source.literal: Land beside her is reached in her boat, or she ties up at a port.

steps.title: No dock
steps.words: A town with no docks has its ships lie off the shore. You reach one in a small boat or by swimming out; a swim says what it will cost you before you press it.

source.literal: A ship lying off this town's own shore (no docks)

steps.title: Below ground
steps.words: This is the site under the place where you found the way down. Rooms you have entered are built; rooms you have only seen are chalk outlines. Underground, the hour makes no difference.

source.literal: Rooms entered are built; rooms only seen are chalk outlines.

steps.title: A quest and a mark
steps.words: Finding the way down into a dungeon opens a quest in the Journal and marks the place, so you can come back. Ways in, on the town and Region maps, lists every site you know.

source.literal: finding the way down gives the quest (see `open_quest`)

steps.title: When it is done
steps.words: The quest is done when whatever holds the last room is beaten, or when every room is entered, its creatures dealt with and its trap disarmed or sprung, whichever comes first.

steps.title: Going through
steps.words: Press a room for the way there, then Walk there: the walk goes through rooms you have stood in. Back up, or zooming out past the site, goes back to the map above.

source.literal:
the engine walks to it through rooms
// stood in only
